fields.nick_h\n\n 2015-03-11 19:13\n\nadministr:
When exporting to GEDCOM, the PLAC tag should contain the place title.

The ADDR tag is used where the information is available. Please note that only a few GEDCOM tags exist for this purpose so the information is likely to be incomplete.

In English, "City" maps to "CITY", but there is no mapping for "Town". The functionality will depend on how the English place types have been translated.
fields.ennoborg\n\n 2015-03-13 18:35\n\ndevelop:
I agree, and according to the GEDCOM standard even more fields of the ADDR tag may be used, like the 1st line, i.e. ADDR itself, for the street, etc. In other words, I'd rather say that Gramps is wrong NOT exporting that street.

But given the lack of consistency in the way addresses are used in genealogy programs all over the world, I see no reason to change anything right away.

fields.daniele\n\n 2017-05-31 07:32\n\nreporter:
I am not sure why my feedback is needed.
What I can confirm is that "City" is "Città" and "Town" may be used for "Città" as weel as "Cittadina" or "Comune" or "Borgo".
